21/// Maximum nesting depth for interpreting `XObject`'s/patterns/streams.
22pub(crate) const MAX_NESTED_INTERPRETATION_DEPTH: u32 = 50;
23/// PdfCraft patch: maximum nesting for content that is painted recursively by the device
24/// (tiling patterns, Type 3 glyphs). Either can refer back to itself through resources it
25/// inherits, which recursed until the stack overflowed (found by fuzzing).
26pub(crate) const MAX_PAINT_NESTING: u32 = 16;
27
28/// PdfCraft patch: how many nested paints (a form inside a form, a Type 3 glyph or tiling
29/// pattern painted from inside another one) one page may do. Nesting depth alone doesn't bound
30/// the work: a glyph that shows ten glyphs of its own font, nested sixteen deep, is 10^16
31/// paints (a fuzzed file hung). Ordinary pages stay far below this.
32pub(crate) const MAX_NESTED_PAINTS: u32 = 50_000;
33
34std::thread_local! {
35    static NESTED_PAINTS: core::cell::Cell<u32> = const { core::cell::Cell::new(0) };
36    static CONTENT_LEFT: core::cell::Cell<usize> = const { core::cell::Cell::new(MAX_PAGE_CONTENT) };
37    // PdfCraft patch (18): whether this page's content budget ran out, reported as
38    // `InterpreterWarning::ContentTruncated`.
39    static CONTENT_TRUNCATED: core::cell::Cell<bool> = const { core::cell::Cell::new(false) };
40    // PdfCraft patch (89): the form XObjects being drawn on this page, outermost first, across
41    // the contexts of the tiling patterns, Type 3 glyphs, soft masks and groups painted while
42    // they draw. A form already on it draws itself and is skipped. Its length is bounded by the
43    // nesting limits: every form on it is nested in the ones before it.
44    static FORMS_DRAWING: RefCell<Vec<crate::third_party::hayro_syntax::object::ObjectIdentifier>> =
45        const { RefCell::new(Vec::new()) };
46}
47
48/// PdfCraft patch: decoded content-stream bytes one page may hold at once: its contents, and
49/// the forms, tiling patterns and Type 3 glyph procedures being painted. Each stream already
50/// stops at `MAX_DECODED_STREAM`, but forms nest fifty deep and every level keeps its content
51/// while the next one runs: a form painting itself around a stream that inflates to 256 MiB
52/// would have held over 12 GB. A level gives its bytes back when it finishes, so content
53/// painted again and again doesn't use the budget up. Ordinary pages hold a few megabytes.
54pub(crate) const MAX_PAGE_CONTENT: usize = 512 << 20;
55
56/// PdfCraft patch: a content stream decoded within the page's [`MAX_PAGE_CONTENT`]. The bytes
57/// it decoded count against the budget until it is dropped; a stream without filters is
58/// borrowed from the file and costs nothing.
59pub(crate) struct DecodedContent<'a> {
60    data: Cow<'a, [u8]>,
61    held: usize,
62}
63
64impl AsRef<[u8]> for DecodedContent<'_> {
65    fn as_ref(&self) -> &[u8] {
66        &self.data
67    }
68}
69
70impl Drop for DecodedContent<'_> {
71    fn drop(&mut self) {
72        let held = self.held;
73        CONTENT_LEFT.with(|c| c.set(c.get().saturating_add(held).min(MAX_PAGE_CONTENT)));
74    }
75}
76
77/// PdfCraft patch: decode a content stream within what is left of this page's
78/// [`MAX_PAGE_CONTENT`]. `None` once the budget is spent (the content is skipped).
79pub(crate) fn decode_content<'a>(stream: &Stream<'a>) -> Option<DecodedContent<'a>> {
80    let left = CONTENT_LEFT.with(core::cell::Cell::get);
81    if left == 0 {
82        CONTENT_TRUNCATED.with(|truncated| truncated.set(true));
83        warn!("page content budget exceeded");
84        return None;
85    }
86    let data = stream.decoded_within(left).ok()?;
87    let held = match &data {
88        Cow::Owned(v) => v.len(),
89        Cow::Borrowed(_) => 0,
90    };
91    charge_content(held);
92    Some(DecodedContent { data, held })
93}
94
95/// PdfCraft patch (87): what is left of this page's [`MAX_PAGE_CONTENT`].
96pub(crate) fn content_left() -> usize {
97    CONTENT_LEFT.with(core::cell::Cell::get)
98}
99
100/// PdfCraft patch (87): `len` bytes of content held within the page's [`MAX_PAGE_CONTENT`]
101/// until dropped, as [`DecodedContent`] holds what it decoded: content kept from an earlier
102/// decode (a cached Type 3 glyph procedure) counts as it did when it was decoded.
103pub(crate) struct HeldContent(usize);
104
105impl Drop for HeldContent {
106    fn drop(&mut self) {
107        let held = self.0;
108        CONTENT_LEFT.with(|c| c.set(c.get().saturating_add(held).min(MAX_PAGE_CONTENT)));
109    }
110}
111
112/// PdfCraft patch (87): hold `len` bytes of content within what is left of the page's
113/// [`MAX_PAGE_CONTENT`]. `None`, and the page reported truncated, when they don't fit, as
114/// [`decode_content`] skips content the budget can't hold.
115pub(crate) fn hold_content(len: usize) -> Option<HeldContent> {
116    let left = content_left();
117    if left == 0 || left < len {
118        CONTENT_TRUNCATED.with(|truncated| truncated.set(true));
119        warn!("page content budget exceeded");
120        return None;
121    }
122    charge_content(len);
123    Some(HeldContent(len))
124}
125
126/// PdfCraft patch: count `len` bytes held for the rest of the page (its own contents).
127pub(crate) fn charge_content(len: usize) {
128    CONTENT_LEFT.with(|c| c.set(c.get().saturating_sub(len)));
129}
130
131/// PdfCraft patch (18): whether content was skipped because the page's budget ran out.
132pub(crate) fn content_was_truncated() -> bool {
133    CONTENT_TRUNCATED.with(core::cell::Cell::get)
134}
135
136/// PdfCraft patch: count a paint at `depth` (top-level ones are free); `false` once this
137/// page's budget is spent, and the paint is skipped.
138pub(crate) fn take_nested_paint(depth: u32) -> bool {
139    if depth < 2 {
140        return true;
141    }
142    NESTED_PAINTS.with(|n| {
143        let used = n.get();
144        if used >= MAX_NESTED_PAINTS {
145            return false;
146        }
147        n.set(used + 1);
148        true
149    })
150}

152/// A cache used by the interpreter.
153///
154/// Ideally, such a cache should be constructed once per PDF and then reused across
155/// multiple interpreter invocations on the same document.
156#[derive(Clone)]
157pub struct InterpreterCache<'a> {
158    pub(crate) font_cache: Rc<RefCell<HashMap<u128, Option<Font<'a>>>>>,
159    pub(crate) object_cache: Cache,
160    /// PdfCraft patch: decoded images, shared by every render through this cache so a tile
161    /// no longer decodes its page's images again.
162    pub(crate) decoded_cache: DecodedImageCache,
163    /// PdfCraft patch (87): what the Type 3 fonts of this cache keep of their decoded glyph
164    /// procedures, together (see `font::type3`).
165    pub(crate) type3_procs: Rc<Type3Procs>,
166}
167
168/// PdfCraft patch (87): decoded Type 3 glyph procedure bytes all the fonts of one
169/// [`InterpreterCache`] keep together. Fonts live as long as the cache, so the bound is on the
170/// cache, not on each font: a document can have thousands of Type 3 fonts.
171pub(crate) const MAX_CACHED_TYPE3_PROCS: usize = 32 << 20;
172
173/// PdfCraft patch (87): the decoded glyph procedure bytes the Type 3 fonts of a cache keep,
174/// and how many procedures they decoded.
175#[derive(Default)]
176pub(crate) struct Type3Procs {
177    pub(crate) held: core::cell::Cell<usize>,
178    pub(crate) decodes: core::cell::Cell<usize>,
179}
180
181impl<'a> Default for InterpreterCache<'a> {
182    fn default() -> Self {
183        Self::new()
184    }
185}

187impl<'a> InterpreterCache<'a> {

189    pub fn new() -> Self {
190        Self {
191            font_cache: Rc::new(RefCell::new(HashMap::new())),
192            object_cache: Cache::new(),
193            decoded_cache: DecodedImageCache::new(),
194            type3_procs: Rc::default(),
195        }
196    }

198    /// PdfCraft patch (87): how many Type 3 glyph procedures the fonts of this cache decoded,
199    /// for diagnostics and tests. A procedure kept from an earlier copy of its glyph isn't
200    /// decoded again.
201    pub fn type3_proc_decodes(&self) -> usize {
202        self.type3_procs.decodes.get()
203    }
204
205    /// PdfCraft patch (32): how many images were decoded through this cache (its misses, not
206    /// counting images that are never cached), for diagnostics and tests.
207    pub fn decoded_image_decodes(&self) -> usize {
208        self.decoded_cache.decodes()
209    }
210
211    /// PdfCraft patch (82): how many of [`Self::decoded_image_decodes`] were of soft masks and
212    /// `/Mask` images, for diagnostics and tests.
213    pub fn decoded_mask_decodes(&self) -> usize {
214        self.decoded_cache.mask_decodes()
215    }
216
217    /// PdfCraft patch (48): how many `/ICCBased` profiles were read through this cache, for
218    /// diagnostics and tests. A profile used again, by the same stream object or by a copy with
219    /// the same dictionary and bytes, is read once.
220    pub fn icc_profile_reads(&self) -> usize {
221        self.object_cache.icc_profile_reads()
222    }
223
224    /// PdfCraft patch (80): how many `/Indexed` lookup tables were read through this cache, for
225    /// diagnostics and tests. A colour space named by a resource is built, and its table read,
226    /// once however many images or colours use it.
227    pub fn indexed_lookup_reads(&self) -> usize {
228        self.object_cache.indexed_lookup_reads()
229    }
230}

232/// A per-page interpretation context that borrows shared data from an [`InterpreterCache`].
233pub struct Context<'a> {
234    states: Vec<State<'a>>,
235    path: BezPath,
236    sub_path_start: Point,
237    last_point: Point,
238    clip: Option<FillRule>,
239    root_transforms: Vec<Affine>,
240    bbox: Vec<Rect>,
241    pub(crate) settings: InterpreterSettings,
242    pub(crate) interpreter_cache: InterpreterCache<'a>,
243    pub(crate) xref: &'a XRef,
244    pub(crate) ocg_state: OcgState,
245    nesting_depth: u32,
246    /// PdfCraft patch: estimated bytes held by saved states, and for each `q` not saved because
247    /// a limit was reached, the clip count to return to at its `Q`.
248    saved_bytes: usize,
249    skipped_saves: Vec<usize>,
250    /// PdfCraft patch (68): the `num_states` at which the nested content stream (a form, an
251    /// appearance, a glyph or pattern cell) being interpreted started, or 0 in page content. A
252    /// `Q` there has no `q` of its own stream to match (see `stream_floor_reached`).
253    stream_floor: usize,
254    // PdfCraft patch (63).
255    /// This is the content of a luminosity soft mask whose group colour space is `/DeviceCMYK`,
256    /// so a `/DeviceCMYK` fill or stroke colour paints as its gray (ISO 32000-2 §11.5.3,
257    /// §10.4.2.3) rather than through the CMYK profile used for display.
258    pub(crate) luminosity_in_device_cmyk: bool,
259}
260
261/// PdfCraft patch: most graphics states saved at once. Every `q` copies the current state, dash
262/// array and clip list included, so without a limit short operators multiply one large state.
263const MAX_SAVED_STATES: usize = 4096;
264/// PdfCraft patch: most bytes all saved states may hold together.
265const MAX_SAVED_STATE_BYTES: usize = 64 << 20;
266
267/// Roughly what a saved copy of `state` holds.
268fn state_bytes(state: &State<'_>) -> usize {
269    size_of::<State<'_>>()
270        .saturating_add(state.graphics_state.stroke_props.dash_array.len().saturating_mul(size_of::<f32>()))
271        .saturating_add(state.clips.len().saturating_mul(size_of::<ClipType>()))
272}

274impl<'a> Context<'a> {
275    /// Create a new context.
276    pub fn new(initial_transform: Affine, bbox: Rect, cache: &InterpreterCache<'a>, xref: &'a XRef, settings: InterpreterSettings) -> Self {
277        let state = State::new(initial_transform);
278        // PdfCraft patch: a page (or other top-level content) starts with fresh budgets.
279        NESTED_PAINTS.with(|n| n.set(0));
280        CONTENT_LEFT.with(|c| c.set(MAX_PAGE_CONTENT));
281        CONTENT_TRUNCATED.with(|truncated| truncated.set(false));
282        // PdfCraft patch (89): no form of another page is being drawn.
283        FORMS_DRAWING.with(|forms| forms.borrow_mut().clear());
284        // PdfCraft patch (73): and fresh JBIG2 decoding, which every image of it shares.
285        crate::third_party::hayro_syntax::set_page_jbig2_work(settings.jbig2_work);
286        // PdfCraft patch (55): a fallback left over from another page is not this page's.
287        crate::third_party::hayro_interpret::color::take_color_fallback();
288        crate::third_party::hayro_interpret::encode::reset_mesh_budget();
289
290        Self::new_with(initial_transform, bbox, cache, xref, settings, state, 0)
291    }
292
293    pub(crate) fn new_with(
294        initial_transform: Affine,
295        bbox: Rect,
296        cache: &InterpreterCache<'a>,
297        xref: &'a XRef,
298        settings: InterpreterSettings,
299        state: State<'a>,
300        nesting_depth: u32,
301    ) -> Self {
302        let mut ocg_state = {
303            let root_ref = xref.root_id();
304            xref.get::<Dict<'_>>(root_ref).map(|catalog| OcgState::from_catalog(&catalog, xref, settings.view_auto_state)).unwrap_or_default()
305        };
306        // PdfCraft patch: apply viewer layer toggles.
307        for (num, generation, visible) in settings.ocg_overrides.iter() {
308            ocg_state.set_active(crate::third_party::hayro_syntax::object::ObjectIdentifier::new(*num, *generation), *visible);
309        }
310
311        Self {
312            states: vec![state],
313            settings,
314            xref,
315            root_transforms: vec![initial_transform],
316            last_point: Point::default(),
317            sub_path_start: Point::default(),
318            clip: None,
319            bbox: vec![bbox],
320            path: BezPath::new(),
321            interpreter_cache: cache.clone(),
322            ocg_state,
323            nesting_depth,
324            saved_bytes: 0,
325            skipped_saves: Vec::new(),
326            stream_floor: 0,
327            luminosity_in_device_cmyk: false,
328        }
329    }
330
331    /// PdfCraft patch (89): begins drawing the form `id`; `false` when that form is already
332    /// being drawn, so drawing it again would never end (ISO 32000-2 §8.10.1: a form is a
333    /// self-contained description; one that contains itself describes nothing finite). The
334    /// skip is reported as `InterpreterWarning::ContentTruncated`. A form without an object
335    /// number can't be told apart and is only bounded by the nesting limits.
336    ///
337    /// The forms being drawn are those of this page's context and of every context painting
338    /// inside it (a tiling pattern, a Type 3 glyph, a soft mask or a group), so a form that
339    /// reaches itself through one of those is skipped too, while a form drawn again after it
340    /// has finished draws as usual.
341    pub(crate) fn enter_form(&mut self, id: Option<crate::third_party::hayro_syntax::object::ObjectIdentifier>) -> bool {
342        let Some(id) = id else {
343            return true;
344        };
345        // The stack is never borrowed across a call, so the borrow succeeds; if it didn't,
346        // the form draws, bounded by the nesting limits as before this patch.
347        let entered = FORMS_DRAWING.with(|forms| {
348            let Ok(mut forms) = forms.try_borrow_mut() else {
349                return None;
350            };
351            if forms.contains(&id) {
352                return Some(false);
353            }
354            forms.push(id);
355            Some(true)
356        });
357        if entered == Some(false) {
358            warn!("form XObject draws itself; the inner drawing is skipped");
359            CONTENT_TRUNCATED.with(|truncated| truncated.set(true));
360            return false;
361        }
362        true
363    }
364
365    /// PdfCraft patch (89): ends drawing a form begun with `enter_form`.
366    pub(crate) fn leave_form(&mut self, id: Option<crate::third_party::hayro_syntax::object::ObjectIdentifier>) {
367        if let Some(id) = id {
368            FORMS_DRAWING.with(|forms| {
369                if let Ok(mut forms) = forms.try_borrow_mut()
370                    && forms.last() == Some(&id)
371                {
372                    forms.pop();
373                }
374            });
375        }
376    }

378    pub(crate) fn save_state(&mut self) {
379        let Some(cur) = self.states.last() else {
380            warn!("attempted to save state without existing state");
381            return;
382        };
383
384        // PdfCraft patch: past either limit the `q` is recorded but nothing is copied. Its `Q`
385        // still removes the clips added since; other changes made in between are kept.
386        let bytes = state_bytes(cur);
387        if !self.skipped_saves.is_empty() || self.states.len() >= MAX_SAVED_STATES || self.saved_bytes.saturating_add(bytes) > MAX_SAVED_STATE_BYTES {
388            if self.skipped_saves.is_empty() {
389                warn!("too many saved graphics states; further saves are not kept");
390            }
391            self.skipped_saves.push(cur.clips.len());
392            return;
393        }
394
395        let cur = cur.clone();
396        self.saved_bytes = self.saved_bytes.saturating_add(bytes);
397        self.states.push(cur);
398    }

400    pub(crate) fn bbox(&self) -> Rect {
401        self.bbox.last().copied().unwrap_or_else(|| {

405        })
406    }

408    fn push_bbox(&mut self, bbox: Rect) {
409        let new = self.bbox().intersect(bbox);
410        self.bbox.push(new);

413    pub(crate) fn push_clip_path(&mut self, clip_path: BezPath, fill: FillRule, device: &mut impl Device<'a>) {
414        if let Some(clip_rect) = path_as_rect(&clip_path) {
415            let cur_bbox = self.bbox();
416
417            // If the clip path is a rect and completely covers the current bbox, don't emit it.
418            if cur_bbox.min_x().is_nearly_greater_or_equal(clip_rect.min_x())
419                && cur_bbox.min_y().is_nearly_greater_or_equal(clip_rect.min_y())
420                && cur_bbox.max_x().is_nearly_less_or_equal(clip_rect.max_x())
421                && cur_bbox.max_y().is_nearly_less_or_equal(clip_rect.max_y())
422            {
423                self.get_mut().clips.push(ClipType::Dummy);
424                return;
425            }
426        }
427
428        let bbox = clip_path.bounding_box();
429        device.push_clip_path(&ClipPath { path: clip_path, fill });
430        self.push_bbox(bbox);
431        self.get_mut().clips.push(ClipType::Real);
432    }
433
434    pub(crate) fn pop_clip_path(&mut self, device: &mut impl Device<'a>) {
435        if let Some(ClipType::Real) = self.get_mut().clips.pop() {
436            device.pop_clip_path();
437            self.pop_bbox();
438        }
439    }

441    fn pop_bbox(&mut self) {
442        self.bbox.pop();
443    }

457    pub(crate) fn restore_state(&mut self, device: &mut impl Device<'a>) {
458        // PdfCraft patch: a save that was not kept is the most recent one.
459        if let Some(target_clips) = self.skipped_saves.pop() {
460            while self.get().clips.len() > target_clips {
461                self.pop_clip_path(device);
462            }
463            return;
464        }
465
466        let Some(target_clips) = self.states.get(self.states.len().saturating_sub(2)).map(|s| s.clips.len()) else {
467            warn!("underflowed graphics state");
468            return;
469        };
470
471        while self.get().clips.len() > target_clips {
472            self.pop_clip_path(device);
473        }
474
475        // The first state should never be popped.
476        if self.states.len() > 1 {
477            self.states.pop();
478            // PdfCraft patch: the state now on top is the copy that was charged when saved.
479            if let Some(top) = self.states.last() {
480                self.saved_bytes = self.saved_bytes.saturating_sub(state_bytes(top));
481            }
482        }
483
484        device.set_soft_mask(self.states.last().and_then(|l| l.graphics_state.soft_mask.clone()));
485    }

531    /// PdfCraft patch (80): an `/Indexed` resource with no lookup table is built, marked
532    /// tableless, for the image and colour operators to handle (see `Indexed::new`).

543
544    /// PdfCraft patch (68): starts a nested content stream at the current depth and returns the
545    /// floor of the stream it runs inside, for `leave_stream`.
546    pub(crate) fn enter_stream(&mut self) -> usize {
547        let depth = self.num_states();
548        std::mem::replace(&mut self.stream_floor, depth)
549    }
550
551    /// PdfCraft patch (68): ends a content stream begun with `enter_stream`.
552    pub(crate) fn leave_stream(&mut self, outer_floor: usize) {
553        self.stream_floor = outer_floor;
554    }
555
556    /// PdfCraft patch (68): every `q` of the current content stream has been matched, so a `Q`
557    /// now would restore a state its caller saved (a stream balances its own `q` and `Q`,
558    /// ISO 32000-2 §8.4.2, §8.10.1).
559    pub(crate) fn stream_floor_reached(&self) -> bool {
560        self.num_states() <= self.stream_floor
561    }
562
563    pub(crate) fn num_states(&self) -> usize {
564        // PdfCraft patch: saves not kept still count, so callers restore back past them.
565        self.states.len().saturating_add(self.skipped_saves.len())
566    }
567
568    pub(crate) fn nesting_depth(&self) -> u32 {
569        self.nesting_depth
570    }
571
572    pub(crate) fn begin_nested_interpretation(&mut self) -> bool {
573        if self.nesting_depth >= MAX_NESTED_INTERPRETATION_DEPTH {
574            warn!("interpreter nesting depth exceeded");
575
576            return false;
577        }
578        if !take_nested_paint(self.nesting_depth + 1) {
579            warn!("nested paint budget exceeded");
580
581            return false;
582        }
583
584        self.nesting_depth += 1;
585
586        true
587    }
588
589    pub(crate) fn end_nested_interpretation(&mut self) {
590        self.nesting_depth = self.nesting_depth.saturating_sub(1);
591    }
592    pub(crate) fn resolve_font(&mut self, font_dict: &Dict<'a>) -> Option<TextStateFont<'a>> {
593        let cache_key = font_dict.cache_key();
594
595        let resolved = {
596            let mut font_cache = self.interpreter_cache.font_cache.borrow_mut();
597            font_cache.entry(cache_key).or_insert_with(|| Font::new(font_dict, &self.settings.font_resolver, &self.settings.cmap_resolver)).clone()
598        };
599
600        // PdfCraft patch (90): tell the caller a Type 3 font lacks the /Widths it requires,
601        // so the spacing taken from its glyph procedures can be reported.
602        if resolved.as_ref().is_some_and(Font::type3_widths_missing) {
603            (self.settings.warning_sink)(InterpreterWarning::Type3WidthsMissing);
604        }
605
606        if let Some(resolved) = resolved {
607            Some(TextStateFont::Font(resolved))
608        } else {
609            Font::new_standard(StandardFont::Helvetica, &self.settings.font_resolver).map(TextStateFont::Fallback)
610        }
611    }
612}
613
614pub(crate) fn path_as_rect(path: &BezPath) -> Option<Rect> {
615    // One MoveTo, three LineTo, one ClosePath
616    if path.elements().len() != 5 {
617        return None;
618    }
619
620    // PdfCraft patch: the points have to trace the rectangle, not merely reach its corners. The
621    // length check above admits one MoveTo and four LineTo as well as the intended one MoveTo,
622    // three LineTo and one ClosePath, and asking only that each corner of the bounding box was
623    // visited says nothing about the order or the steps between: a five-point polyline whose
624    // ends reached every corner of its own bounding box was painted as that box, and a clip of
625    // that shape was discarded. Four distinct points, each step along one axis, the last point
626    // back at the first: that is a rectangle and nothing else is.
627    let mut points: Vec<Point> = Vec::with_capacity(5);
628    let mut closed = false;
629    for (idx, el) in path.elements().iter().enumerate() {
630        match el {
631            PathEl::MoveTo(p) => {
632                if idx != 0 {
633                    return None;
634                }
635                points.push(*p);
636            }
637            PathEl::LineTo(p) => points.push(*p),
638            PathEl::QuadTo(_, _) => return None,
639            PathEl::CurveTo(_, _, _) => return None,
640            // A subpath that ends and starts again is more than one shape.
641            PathEl::ClosePath => {
642                if idx + 1 != path.elements().len() {
643                    return None;
644                }
645                closed = true;
646            }
647        }
648    }
649
650    // Exactly equal, not nearly: `is_nearly_equal` allows a 256th of a path unit, and the matrix
651    // is applied after this, so a `cm` of 10,000 turns that into tens of device units -- a path
652    // that only nearly closes would be painted as the rectangle, with a side it does not have.
653    // A rectangle's coordinates are equal in the content stream, not approximately equal, so
654    // nothing that is one loses the fast path by this; a path that misses takes the general route
655    // and is painted as written (#3327 review).
656    let same = |a: Point, b: Point| a.x == b.x && a.y == b.y;
657    // `m l l l l`: the fourth line goes back to the start, which `m l l l h` does with ClosePath.
658    if !closed {
659        if points.len() != 5 || !same(points[4], points[0]) {
660            return None;
661        }
662        points.pop();
663    }
664    if points.len() != 4 {
665        return None;
666    }
667    // Distinct, so a degenerate path is not one, and each step along one axis only: the four
668    // points of an axis-aligned rectangle, in order round it.
669    for (i, p) in points.iter().enumerate() {
670        let q = points[(i + 1) % 4];
671        let along_x = p.y == q.y && p.x != q.x;
672        let along_y = p.x == q.x && p.y != q.y;
673        if !(along_x || along_y) {
674            return None;
675        }
676        if points.iter().skip(i + 1).any(|o| same(*p, *o)) {
677            return None;
678        }
679    }
680
681    Some(path.fast_bounding_box())
682}

684/// PdfCraft patch tests (ported from craft-libs): the graphics-state stack is bounded by count
685/// and by bytes, and every `q` still pairs with its `Q`.
686#[cfg(any())]
687mod saved_state_tests {
688    use super::*;
689    use crate::third_party::hayro_interpret::device::DummyDevice;
690    use crate::third_party::hayro_syntax::Pdf;
691
692    fn pdf() -> Pdf {
693        let objects = ["<< /Type /Catalog /Pages 2 0 R >>", "<< /Type /Pages /Count 0 /Kids [] >>"];
694        let mut out = b"%PDF-1.7\n".to_vec();
695        let mut offsets = Vec::new();
696        for (i, body) in objects.iter().enumerate() {
697            offsets.push(out.len());
698            out.extend_from_slice(format!("{} 0 obj\n{body}\nendobj\n", i + 1).as_bytes());
699        }
700        let xref = out.len();
701        out.extend_from_slice(b"xref\n0 3\n0000000000 65535 f \n");
702        for offset in offsets {
703            out.extend_from_slice(format!("{offset:010} 00000 n \n").as_bytes());
704        }
705        out.extend_from_slice(format!("trailer\n<< /Size 3 /Root 1 0 R >>\nstartxref\n{xref}\n%%EOF\n").as_bytes());
706        Pdf::new(out).expect("synthetic pdf")
707    }
708
709    fn triangle() -> BezPath {
710        let mut path = BezPath::new();
711        path.move_to((10.0, 10.0));
712        path.line_to((90.0, 10.0));
713        path.line_to((50.0, 90.0));
714        path.close_path();
715        path
716    }
717
718    /// Saves `saves` more times, checks a clip added after the last save goes at its `Q`, and unwinds.
719    fn save_and_unwind(ctx: &mut Context<'_>, saves: usize) {
720        let before = ctx.num_states();
721        for _ in 0..saves {
722            ctx.save_state();
723        }
724        assert!(ctx.states.len() <= MAX_SAVED_STATES);
725        assert!(ctx.saved_bytes <= MAX_SAVED_STATE_BYTES);
726        assert_eq!(ctx.num_states(), before + saves, "every q still counts");
727
728        let mut device = DummyDevice;
729        let clips = ctx.get().clips.len();
730        ctx.push_clip_path(triangle(), FillRule::NonZero, &mut device);
731        assert_eq!(ctx.get().clips.len(), clips + 1);
732        ctx.restore_state(&mut device);
733        assert_eq!(ctx.get().clips.len(), clips);
734
735        while ctx.num_states() > 1 {
736            ctx.restore_state(&mut device);
737        }
738        assert_eq!(ctx.states.len(), 1);
739        assert!(ctx.skipped_saves.is_empty());
740        assert_eq!(ctx.saved_bytes, 0);
741    }
742
743    #[cfg(any())]
744    fn repeated_saves_stay_bounded_and_balanced() {
745        let pdf = pdf();
746        let cache = InterpreterCache::new();
747        let bbox = Rect::new(0.0, 0.0, 100.0, 100.0);
748        let settings = InterpreterSettings::default();
749        let mut ctx = Context::new(Affine::IDENTITY, bbox, &cache, pdf.xref(), settings);
750
751        // A small state reaches the count limit.
752        save_and_unwind(&mut ctx, 20_000);
753
754        // A large one (a 64 Ki-entry dash array, 256 KiB a copy) reaches the byte limit first.
755        ctx.get_mut().graphics_state.stroke_props.dash_array = (0..1 << 16).map(|_| 2.0).collect();
756        ctx.save_state();
757        assert_eq!(ctx.states.len(), 2);
758        while ctx.skipped_saves.is_empty() {
759            ctx.save_state();
760        }
761        assert!(ctx.states.len() < MAX_SAVED_STATES);
762        save_and_unwind(&mut ctx, 1000);
763
764        // Once unwound, a kept save restores what changed after it.
765        let mut device = DummyDevice;
766        ctx.save_state();
767        ctx.pre_concat_affine(Affine::scale(2.0));
768        ctx.restore_state(&mut device);
769        assert_eq!(ctx.get().ctm, Affine::IDENTITY);
770    }
771}
